name: cancel-mid-turn
description: A turn cancelled while in flight must emit the terminal `cancelled` event (status 499, echoing the CANCELLED TURN's requestId) IN PLACE OF `eventual_response`, and must free the connection's turn slot so the next `send_message` is accepted. The in-flight window is made deterministic by parking the turn on write-confirmation HITL (`server.confirmTools`) — a mock turn otherwise completes faster than a `cancel` frame can race it, and the scenario format has no way to express a slow tool. Per spec/actions/cancel.schema.json the cancel frame carries the requestId of the `send_message` it aborts; per spec/events/cancelled.schema.json the cancelled turn produces NO answer payload.
